pyramiding_rule: Absolute prohibition of adding to positions during active drawdown or within 15 minutes of a prior stopped-out ticket.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Volume-weighted MACD histogram divergence confirmation combined with zero-spread spread check and ATR filter > 2.5 on XAUUSD 1-minute blocks.
profit_harvest_threshold: Scale out 50% of position at +$10.00 and trail remaining volume with a strict 30-period exponential moving average band.
